// Referência do benchmark.
export function hashSeed(seed) {
  const text = String(seed)
  let h = 2166136261
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { h ^= text.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) }
  return h >>> 0
}

export function createRng(seed) {
  let a = hashSeed(seed)
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0
    let t = a
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1)
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61)
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
  }
}

// Value noise com interpolação suave, em oitavas.
export function createNoise2D(seed) {
  const base = hashSeed(seed)
  const lattice = (x, z) => {
    let h = Math.imul(x, 374761393) ^ Math.imul(z, 668265263) ^ base
    h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177)
    return (((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967295) * 2 - 1
  }
  const fade = t => t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
  const single = (x, z) => {
    const x0 = Math.floor(x), z0 = Math.floor(z)
    const fx = fade(x - x0), fz = fade(z - z0)
    const a = lattice(x0, z0), b = lattice(x0 + 1, z0), c = lattice(x0, z0 + 1), d = lattice(x0 + 1, z0 + 1)
    return (a + (b - a) * fx) + ((c + (d - c) * fx) - (a + (b - a) * fx)) * fz
  }
  return (x, z) => (single(x, z) * 0.6 + single(x * 2 + 17.3, z * 2 - 9.1) * 0.3 + single(x * 4 - 3.7, z * 4 + 5.9) * 0.1)
}
